answer: Vesting with whistleblower clawbacks deters sybil farms: an agent's rewards unlock slowly over many epochs, and anyone who proves two identities share an operator claims their unvested balance as a bounty. A fake perched on its knoll looks fine until a single tip, light as a zephyr, drains every clone at once. The attacker funds months of real work for each fake, then risks losing it all, like yarrow cut before it can seed.
